verdict.rationale: E2B has a documented CLI, SDK, and non-interactive auth mode explicitly recommended for CI/CD pipelines, servers, and containers, plus scriptable sandbox lifecycle (create, exec with --background, shutdown, snapshot) and webhooks for lifecycle events — all consistent with headless/CI automation. missing for 10: no independent third-party report of a real CI pipeline using E2B, and no explicit CI provider integration examples (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow snippet).
